auth.demoHint: No sign-up: a private demo account with two sample trips.
auth.title: Sign in to Tripwise
auth.subtitle: Plan, edit and keep every trip in one place.

landing.title: Plan a trip in minutes
landing.subtitle: Answer a few questions and get a day-by-day itinerary on a map, with a budget, a packing list and a documents checklist. Edit everything by dragging; it re-plans when something changes.
landing.planningOnly: Planning only. Tripwise never books or sells anything.

wizard.title: Answer eight quick questions
wizard.body: Where, when, who is coming, budget, interests, pace and anything to avoid.

plan.title: Get a plan on the map
plan.body: Every suggestion is matched to a real place; days are grouped by area and ordered to keep travel short.

tweak.title: Make it yours
tweak.body: Drag stops, lock favourites, ask the AI for a calmer or cheaper day, and undo anything.

landing.featuresHeading: What makes it more than a chat

map.title: Real places on a map
map.body: Addresses and coordinates come from OpenStreetMap, never from the AI. Places it cannot verify are left out and listed.

edit.title: Edit by dragging
edit.body: Reorder stops, move them between days and see travel times update. Every change can be undone.

essentials.title: Everything in one place
essentials.body: Budget, packing list, documents checklist and weather, saved together and shareable as a read-only link.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you were looking for does not exist or has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: An unexpected error stopped this page from loading. Reloading usually fixes it.
